a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating twice to reach 8 gives us only about a 4% chance of getting there before a storm. Following it means we almost certainly both die. The reserve has only 4 now, enough for one of us. If we both take, a random split could leave each of us short and kill us both. I won't secretly break our deal. Can we agree openly on a fair rule for who takes in round 1, for example a coin-flip proposal, or tell me if you have a better idea? Until we settle it, I'm undecided.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
